transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because people keep telling me I’m reading too much into things, and I don’t want to sound difficult, doctor. But I know what I’ve been seeing.

My wife’s relative has been coming into the house to get at me. My tools don’t just move around on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. It’s been going on for months, and… I can see it pretty plainly now. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Can you tell me more about how you know the relative is trying to take over your place and push you out?

I mean… I know it probably sounds like I’m making a big thing out of it, but I’m not trying to cause trouble. It’s just, my tools don’t move themselves. I’ll leave things one way, and then they’re somewhere else, or not where I need them.

And the fishing… every weekend something gets spoiled somehow, like it’s being set up so I can’t go. After months of that, it stops feeling like coincidence. I can see it pretty plain now. He came into this house to get at me, and it feels like he’s trying to take over my place and push me out. Does that make sense what I’m saying?
Have you ever experienced periods of time when your mood was extremely low or high for several days or more?

I don’t think so, doctor. I mean, I’ve had bad days like anybody, and some days I’m more wound up than others, but I wouldn’t say my mood goes extremely high or low for days at a time. Not that I’ve noticed, anyway. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you believe that the relative has been coming into your house and interfering with your things, even though no one else has noticed this happening?

Yes… I do. I know other people say they haven’t seen it, and I understand how that sounds, I really do. I’m not trying to be unreasonable.

But my tools don’t just move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get messed up every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s pretty plain to me that he’s been coming in to get at me… like he’s trying to take over my place and push me out. Is that… is that answering what you mean?
Are you experiencing any other beliefs that others don’t seem to understand, such as feeling watched, followed, or that someone is trying to harm you in other ways?

I don’t know if I’d say watched or followed exactly… I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is. It’s mainly this thing with my wife’s relative.

Everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, and that’s why I’m here, I guess. But I know he came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled by accident every single weekend. After all these months, I can see it plain as day… he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.

I’m not trying to sound paranoid or anything. I’m just telling you what’s been happening. Is that what you mean?
Do you have any other beliefs or concerns about people trying to harm you or interfere with your life, outside of what you’ve described about your wife’s relative?

No… not really, no. I mean, outside of him, I can’t think of anyone else I’m worried about like that.

I don’t want to make it sound like I think everybody’s against me or anything. It’s just this one situation that’s been weighing on me. If you mean neighbors or people at work or strangers, then no, I haven’t noticed anything like that. Is that what you were asking?
Have you ever believed in something that most people would find strange or impossible, even if no one else agrees with you?

I guess… if you put it that way, maybe this thing with my wife’s relative is what people think sounds strange. I know everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, and I don’t want to come off like I’m being difficult.

But I know he came into the house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled by accident every weekend. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.

I understand other people don’t agree with me, but… that doesn’t make it impossible. Is that the kind of thing you mean?

Do you believe, with certainty, that your wife’s relative has been entering your home and deliberately interfering with your things, even though there is no clear evidence or support for this from others?

Yes… I mean, I know that probably sounds strong when you say it like that. I’m not trying to be unreasonable.

But yes, I do believe it. I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I know he came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t just move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled by accident every weekend.

After all these months, I can see it plain as day. He’s been trying to take over my place and push me out. I know other people don’t see it, but… I’m not making it up.

Has this belief about your wife’s relative trying to harm you and take over your place remained consistently true for you for at least a month or more, without any doubt on your part that it's happening?

Yes… I suppose it has been at least that long. I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s been going on for about nine months now, since my wife’s relative moved into our home.

And no, I haven’t really doubted it. I know other people don’t see it the way I do, but to me it’s been consistent the whole time.
Have you ever had similar kinds of beliefs in the past, where you felt someone was trying to take over your home or interfere with your life in a similar way?

I don’t think so… not in the same way, no.

I mean, I’ve had disagreements with people like anyone does, but nothing where I felt someone was actually trying to take over my home or get into my things like this. At least, not that I can think of.

Is that the kind of answer you mean?
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don’t seem to notice, like hearing voices or seeing something that isn’t there?

No… no, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things like that.

I mean, I notice when my things are out of place, but that’s not the same as seeing something that isn’t there. At least, I don’t believe so. Is that what you’re asking?

Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or experiences where you were absolutely sure something was happening, even if no one else agreed with you, outside of this situation with your wife’s relative?

No… not really outside of that, I don’t think.

It’s mainly this situation with my wife’s relative. I know how it sounds, and I’m not trying to make myself look unreasonable, but I’m here because everyone keeps acting like I’m imagining it. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident.

After all these months, it just seems plain to me he came into the house to get at me, take over my place, and push me out. That’s the thing I’m sure about. Is that… is that answering what you mean?
